text:
maria: heads-up — canary p95 decode jumped ~2.3x after merge 4a7f2e5. dashboard: https://perf.redwood/internal/decodes?sha=4a7f2e5

aj: ack. single host or fleet?

maria: single host canary in us-east-1. seq mix short/med. p50 unchanged, p95 220ms -> 520ms.

ci-bot: [perf-monitor] Canary job 'decode-p95-canary' exceeded threshold at sha 4a7f2e5 (p95 520ms, baseline 210ms). Details: https://ci.redwood/reports/2255

cheng: looked at perf dump and flamegraphs — new kernel ranking logic is preferring fused_op_reorder for short sequences. that path adds an extra device memcpy in the KV cache hotpath. snippet from perf profile:
```
# kernel_selector: fused_op_reorder chosen for layer 3
memcpy_device  14.2% 
kv_read       9.8% (more misses)
decode_tokens 32.1%
```

nora: can we force the previous selector quickly to see if it stabilizes?

cheng: yes. there's an env toggle: KERNEL_POLICY=legacy_selector will skip the reorder heuristic. restart runtime to pick up.

aj: also noticed commit bumped batch_window_ms from 3 -> 6ms in the same PR — doubling the batching window increases number of partial batches and might aggravate KV eviction patterns.

maria: confirmed in git diff: batch_window_ms: 3 -> 6 in 4a7f2e5. combined effect seems plausible.

cheng: i reproduced locally with microbench: with selector=auto + batch=6ms p95 goes 180 -> 470ms. with KERNEL_POLICY=legacy_selector and batch=6ms p95 ~190ms. small reproducer attached.

aj: plan: 1) ops pin KERNEL_POLICY=legacy_selector on canary 2) run perf for 30m 3) if stable either revert ranking change or change default to legacy and open hotfix PR. owners: tom (ops), cheng (fix).

nora: i'll run a targeted bisect on the PR to isolate the exact line that changed kernel ranking vs batch param.

tom: ops can push the env override to canary in ~5m. will include a restart and smoke checks. revert plan ready.

ops-bot: deploy started by tom -> canary: set env KERNEL_POLICY=legacy_selector; restart redwood-runtime.service. CI tag: deploy/2255-canary-override

maria: after override p95 back to ~190ms. watching for 15m. :thumbsup:

aj: please also file a CI perf test to catch batch_window_ms increases — current CI doesn't cover short-seq KV-cache churn.

cheng: filing PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3098 — pins selector and adds a microbench perf test that asserts p95 delta < 15% for short-seq workloads.

nora: bisect shows the kernel_ranking comparator change happened on line that introduced 'prefers_reorder=true' inside selector.cpp. will include patch to gate it behind a flag.

tom: canary stable for 25m with override. rolling to additional canaries tomorrow unless PR lands.

maria: note for release notes / postmortem: avoid changing kernel ranking and batch_window in the same PR. they interact non-obviously.

aj: agreed. i'll open an RFC for changelist requirements + mandatory perf run for batching/kernel heuristics.

maria: thanks all. closing this thread once PR merges.

cheng: follow-up: add perf histogram output to the test so we have p50/p95 buckets in CI logs.

maria: good call.

nora: logging the incident: INCIDENT-2255 (decode-p95-canary). owners: tom, cheng.

maria: done. end.
